datasets.title: Quarterly public debt composition
datasets.description: Public debt composition across every listed quarterly edition from September 2022 to June 2026, retaining each edition’s historical comparisons and debt scope.
datasets.caveat: Reported totals overlap components. June values are provisional; debt perimeter differs from the CBSL annual continuity series. Historical reporting perimeters and classifications change; comparison-period revisions remain separate by reporting_period. No Q4 2022 bulletin is listed; December 2022 appears as a comparison in Q1 2023.
datasets.vintage: 2022 Q3–2026 Q2; 15 reporting editions with earlier comparison periods

datasets.title: Domestic government debt by instrument
datasets.description: Domestic government instruments across all 15 listed quarterly editions, including original USD and USD-million/LKR-billion reporting units.
datasets.caveat: Bills include interest. Amounts are positions, not new borrowing. Historical reporting perimeters and classifications change; comparison-period revisions remain separate by reporting_period. No Q4 2022 bulletin is listed; December 2022 appears as a comparison in Q1 2023. Earlier tables use USD, not USD million.
datasets.vintage: 2022 Q3–2026 Q2; 15 reporting editions with earlier comparison periods

datasets.title: External debt by creditor
datasets.description: External government debt by creditor country and organization across all 15 listed quarterly editions; unpaid principal is included where published.
datasets.caveat: Subtotal rows overlap individual creditors; creditor classes must not be combined blindly. Historical reporting perimeters and classifications change; comparison-period revisions remain separate by reporting_period. No Q4 2022 bulletin is listed; December 2022 appears as a comparison in Q1 2023.
datasets.vintage: 2022 Q3–2026 Q2; 15 reporting editions with earlier comparison periods

datasets.title: Local-authority debt by province
datasets.description: Local-authority debt and reporting-authority counts by province across the seven quarterly tables from December 2024 through June 2026.
datasets.caveat: These are local-authority aggregates within provinces, not the borrowing of provincial councils. September 2025 Central Province has a printed USD/LKR conversion discrepancy retained as reported.

datasets.title: SOE annual financial performance
datasets.description: Financial line items for named public enterprises from the 2025 Final Budget Position Report.
datasets.caveat: Accounts and line items differ by enterprise. Subtotals overlap components. Latest values may be provisional; each row cites its table page.

datasets.title: SOE sector financial outturn
datasets.description: 2025 revenue, 2024–2025 pre-tax profit/loss and SOE counts by sector.
datasets.caveat: Sector totals cover the stated SOEs, with provisional values; this is not every state-linked enterprise.

datasets.title: Government revenue budget and outturn
datasets.description: Government revenue estimates and actual receipts from the Treasury annual report.
datasets.caveat: Revenue categories include subtotals. Preserve source accounting classification and units.

datasets.title: Fiscal budget versus actual performance
datasets.description: 2025 fiscal performance against budget in the 2027 Fiscal Strategy Statement.
datasets.caveat: Actual, budget, deviation and GDP shares are different measures; rows overlap in the source hierarchy.

datasets.title: In-year fiscal performance
datasets.description: January–April fiscal receipts and spending compared with annual budgets, 2025 and 2026.
datasets.caveat: Jan–Apr flows are not full-year values; percentage columns retain the published denominator.

datasets.title: Banking and finance-company soundness
datasets.description: Published financial soundness indicators for banks and finance companies.
datasets.caveat: Sector aggregates; 2025 provisional. Indicator definitions and denominators differ.

datasets.title: Procurement outcomes
datasets.description: Reported procurement monitoring for selected public institutions, 2022–2024, 2025 and 2026 H1.
datasets.caveat: Selected high-value procurements only. ND is missing, not zero. The 2022–2024 window is pooled; its award-value column is an average.

datasets.title: Procurement bid competition
datasets.description: Reported procurement monitoring for selected public institutions, 2022–2024, 2025 and 2026 H1.
datasets.caveat: Selected high-value procurements only. ND is missing, not zero. The 2022–2024 window is pooled; its award-value column is an average.

datasets.title: Competitive procurement awards
datasets.description: Reported procurement monitoring for selected public institutions, 2022–2024, 2025 and 2026 H1.
datasets.caveat: Selected high-value procurements only. ND is missing, not zero. The 2022–2024 window is pooled; its award-value column is an average.

datasets.title: Government transfers to provinces
datasets.description: 2025 recurrent and capital transfers to provincial councils.
datasets.caveat: Central-government transfers are not the same as provincial expenditure. Values are provisional.

datasets.title: Women-owned and led MSME finance
datasets.description: Loan and deposit balances/counts by women-owned/led status in the 2025/2026 WE Finance Code report.
datasets.caveat: Reporting signatory counts differ by indicator. This is not a national firm census or household data.

datasets.title: Treasury guarantees by institution and facility
datasets.description: June 2026 facility-level original commitments and outstanding capital, with banks, issue/expiry dates and separate currency columns.
datasets.caveat: Merged outstanding balances are separate shared-facility records, never allocated to individual loans. Blank currency cells remain missing. Printed guarantee totals do not fully reconcile with the listed cells; consult the source discrepancy note.

datasets.title: Treasury letters of comfort by institution
datasets.description: June 2026 facility-level original commitments and outstanding capital, with banks, issue/expiry dates and separate currency columns.
datasets.caveat: Three printed facilities with original and outstanding amounts in separate currencies. Expired issue/expiry dates are retained as printed; blanks are not zeros.
